reasoning: Per-step verdicts give a single, high-confidence deterministic global step: saturate_weaken_HSV severity 4 (LIKELY, Tier 1, PSNR=inf / MSE=0 on all 5 support pairs, CI=10/10). Compression, noise and blur are each explicitly absent per 0% FP rules (block_boundary < 1.01; sigma <= 0.25 with peeled residual std=0.0; gm_ratio ~1.0 with the pair0 glass signal refuted by exact reproduction). The only components with a documented gate are therefore: (1) SimpleGate — default-on, -32K params, safe on 8/9 degradations and required by the 'low difficulty (saturation) -> pure Swin + SimpleGate' rule (Section 六 Step 0, Section 五 exp39); and (2) everything else — off. ColorPre/FiLM-GCM are gated on a coherent variance_ratio deviation with structural content: here variance_ratio swings both directions (0.855-1.388), contrast_from_variance is false in 4/5 pairs (pair2 was corrected as contrast_from_saturation), and the pump in channel means is the known coupling artifact of HSV desaturation. Moreover Section 七 lists saturation as a ColorPre-harmful scenario (-0.34 dB) and Section 五 lists saturation as 'Direct + pure Swin, components ~0 dB'. OCAB's anisotropy>1.7 gate reads 1.8149 only on the rejected glass FP in pair0, and OCAB is documented as worse than Swin on global degradations. ColorMLP needs a high-confidence brightness_HSV step, but brightness_detected_raw flips 2/5 and is fully explained by desaturation. DualBranch is explicitly barred in blind-recognition settings (exp37 0/24; Section 七) despite the per-pair heuristic in full_analysis.json. CSN is barred on pure global degradations (L6 -4.60, SF9 -11.73). Swin (window 8) is chosen as the validated baseline for global color-type degradations. Training is Direct from scratch (no pretrained ckpt available; Section 六 Step 1 and exp37 show True Ft ~= Direct anyway), 2 epochs, lr 5e-4 (also the safe LR that avoids any component instability), batch 16. Risk note: SimpleGate showed an epoch-2 checkpoint regression on D3 (JPEG+blur, Section 五 exp39) — that pipeline has structural steps; this challenge does not, but the epoch-2 checkpoint should still be monitored and best-by-val ckpt retained.
